scope: 32 core player profiles; runtime details and enemy tuning are exported in playable-content-catalog.json

growth.mode: linear increases from level 1 base; no compounding
growth.enemy_policy: Same shallow HP and damage growth; fixed type defenses and critical profiles

progression_policy: Recruitment branches of separate cards. Every card levels to 20. Peasant does not automatically become a knight; cheap troops retain an economic role.
historical_scope: Medieval European inspiration across periods, combined with explicitly fantasy characters; no claim that all types belonged to one historical army.

core_units.name: Peasant
core_units.equipment_brief: Club or improvised agricultural tool; ordinary clothes
core_units.identity: Cheapest single body; quick deployment lets it buy a moment for another recruit.
core_units.weakness: Very low damage and protection; cannot hold a durable enemy alone.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Militia
core_units.identity: One payment deploys two bodies, offering a broader early blocking line.
core_units.equipment_brief: Short spears; padded clothing and simple helmets
core_units.weakness: Splash punishes the pair; each body is fragile.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Spearman
core_units.identity: Cheap reach behind another melee body; its committed thrust answers physical armor.
core_units.weakness: Poor close defense when a flanker reaches it.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Archer
core_units.identity: Affordable ordinary ranged support with a limited volley.
core_units.weakness: Needs protection and contributes no ordinary structure damage.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Swordsman
core_units.identity: Reliable mobile generalist with a modest cleave.
core_units.equipment_brief: Arming sword; padded armor with some mail
core_units.weakness: No specialist answer to heavy armor, wards, or ranged focus.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Field Medic
core_units.identity: Channels repeated healing into one injured patient.
core_units.weakness: Interrupted healing stops; requires an intact frontline.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Axeman
core_units.equipment_brief: One-handed axe and small shield; light mail
core_units.identity: Committed chops do extra damage to temporary shields and breakable tactical blockers.
core_units.weakness: Short reach; the bonus does not bypass permanent armor or create a structure-damage premium.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Maceman
core_units.identity: Every third committed hit briefly reduces one enemy armor rating for allied follow-up.
core_units.weakness: Slow windup; must survive repeated contact.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Caravan Engineer
core_units.identity: Repairs the wagon and maintains one temporary repairable bolt emplacement.
core_units.weakness: Low personal damage and a vulnerable setup; construction support is its main job.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Billman
core_units.identity: A marked hook attack pulls an eligible ordinary enemy a short distance into the line.
core_units.weakness: Cannot drag bosses or anchored targets; recovery exposes it to nearby attackers.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Man-at-Arms
core_units.equipment_brief: Sword and buckler; mail with plate reinforcements
core_units.identity: Alternates ordinary strikes with a short personal physical guard window.
core_units.weakness: Moderate cost and damage; its guard does not protect allies or stop magical damage.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Crossbowman
core_units.identity: Deliberate precision shots and a special aimed at a distant priority target.
core_units.weakness: Lower movement and firing cadence than light melee.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Shield Knight
core_units.identity: Holds contact and periodically intercepts an eligible projectile aimed at a nearby ally.
core_units.equipment_brief: Large shield and sword; substantial armor
core_units.weakness: Limited interception allowance; vulnerable to magical damage and field hazards.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Battle Monk
core_units.identity: Maintains its combat aura and periodic area healing.
core_units.weakness: Lower patient healing than the Medic; dispersed allies miss the aura.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Paladin
core_units.identity: Protecting a wounded ally charges a radiant melee strike and a limited allied shield.
core_units.weakness: High cost; needs a nearby patient and has a long support cooldown.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Pikeman
core_units.identity: Braces against a telegraphed charge and interrupts the first eligible charger reaching the point.
core_units.equipment_brief: Long pike; helmet and body armor
core_units.weakness: Moving or displacement cancels the brace; flankers can close inside its reach.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Halberdier
core_units.identity: Combines reach with a committed frontal sweep against clustered troops.
core_units.weakness: Sweep recovery creates a punish window; ordinary stronghold damage replaces its siege premium.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Cavalry Rider
core_units.identity: Makes an offensive line charge, then commits to close combat.
core_units.equipment_brief: Lance and sword; horse and rider armor
core_units.weakness: A braced defender stops the charge; expensive losses.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Gravebound Knight
core_units.identity: Returns once at 25% of maximum HP and permanently reduced speed; the return is part of its survivability budget.
core_units.weakness: Corpse denial prevents return; revival sources share one return allowance.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Greatswordsman
core_units.equipment_brief: Large two-handed sword; moderate body armor
core_units.identity: A long frontal cut reaches up to three closely aligned ordinary targets.
core_units.weakness: Slow committed swing and little rear protection; this is a game specialization inspired by late medieval two-handed swords.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Quartermaster
core_units.identity: Qualifying nearby allied kills produce small manually collected courage packs on a shared cooldown.
core_units.weakness: Low direct damage; no rewards from summoned or artificial targets.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Berserker
core_units.identity: Missing health increases its offensive pressure and frenzy accelerates real attack recovery.
core_units.weakness: Low protection; burst or ranged focus can kill it before its pressure pays off.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Sapper Crew
core_units.identity: A close-range setup plants demolition against a structure or explicitly fortified target.
core_units.equipment_brief: Tools and a timed charge; protected two-person crew
core_units.weakness: Two vulnerable bodies, weak ordinary combat, interruptible setup.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Outrider
core_units.identity: Intercepts the first threat nearing the wagon, then fights as a fast light melee troop.
core_units.equipment_brief: Light cavalry weapon; light rider protection
core_units.weakness: One interception; less sustained toughness than the offensive Cavalry Rider.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Longbowman
core_units.identity: Charges a powerful straight shot while stationary.
core_units.weakness: Displacement loses the charge; poor close defense.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Warhammer Knight
core_units.identity: Every fourth committed heavy hit interrupts an eligible windup or channel with a short stagger.
core_units.weakness: Must stay in contact; control resistance prevents a permanent lock.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Rogue
core_units.identity: Targets an exposed backline and gains a real next-strike bonus after Vanish.
core_units.weakness: Fragile when revealed or caught by area attacks.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Duelist
core_units.identity: Parries one telegraphed melee strike and ripostes against that opponent.
core_units.weakness: A single-target defense; projectiles and multiple attackers overwhelm it.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Mage
core_units.identity: Provides magical direct damage and a line-piercing Arcane Beam.
core_units.weakness: A small late support option; fragile and vulnerable to null fields.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Poleaxe Knight
core_units.identity: Alternates a committed crushing blow and a thrust with personal physical-armor penetration.
core_units.weakness: High cost and slow recovery; penetration helps its own hit rather than exposing armor for the whole squad.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Banner Knight
core_units.identity: Fights at the front while rallying nearby allies offensively.
core_units.weakness: Needs a nearby formation and lacks Shield Knight projectile interception.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed

core_units.name: Ballista Crew
core_units.identity: Sustained ranged structure pressure with an armor-piercing marked siege shot.
core_units.weakness: Slow deployment and recovery; vulnerable to close attackers.
core_units.status: implemented with placeholder art as needed
